name: Doty Ravine Preserve — monthly
description: Placer Land Trust preserve north of Lincoln, CA. Process-based restoration (beaver dam analogues + natural beaver recolonization) beginning ~2014 reconnected ~60 acres of floodplain along Doty Ravine, a tributary of Coon Creek.

analysisAreas.label: Restored floodplain
analysisAreas.notes: The ~60-acre reconnected floodplain west of Gladding Rd (approximate footprint, inferred — replace with parcel/project boundary when available).

analysisAreas.label: Upstream corridor (control)
analysisAreas.notes: Riparian corridor east of Gladding Rd, upstream of the floodplain work — same stream, no floodplain reconnection. Verify no PBR occurred here.

analysisAreas.label: Dry grassland (reference)
analysisAreas.notes: Non-riparian annual grassland south of the corridor; tracks the climate signal so treatment divergence from it is attributable to the water table, not weather.

notes: Center set on the preserve reach of Doty Ravine: 'off Gladding and Manzanita Roads, near Manzanita Cemetery' (cemetery at 38.9440, -121.3039 per OSM), stream at lat ~38.939 there. Verified against calibration frames 2025-Q3. Monthly-cadence variant of doty-ravine; same AOI, views, events, and analysis areas.
